name: 삼도천 뱀장어
quote: 흐르는 물결을 따라, 저승의 길을 닦으러 왔나니.
eyes: 연꽃 등불의 빛이 투영된 빛나는 점
silhouette: 길게 늘어진 유선형 몸체, 등 부분에 튀어나온 둥근 연꽃 형태, 꼬리의 뾰족한 끝
visual_en: A long, slender eel-like body with translucent cyan scales. The creature lacks legs, moving with a serpentine shape. On its dorsal fin, a small, glowing golden lotus lantern is perched, casting a bright light. The head features a faint, glowing white dot representing eyes. The tail tapers into a sharp, pointed tip. The entire body has a watery, shimmering effect with subtle white bubbles along the edges of its fins.
pose_en: Swaying rhythmically like a wave in a dark river.
vfx_en: Soft yellow glow emanating from the lotus lantern.
motion_en: Undulating side to side like a flowing river.
concept: 저승길 — 한국 저승 설화(저승차사 · 옥졸 · 삼도천 · 명부 · 염라). 무섭되 이 게임의 2~3등신 치비 도트, 어두운 돌바닥과 밝은 회색 바닥 둘 다에서 보이는 몸 색.

body_plan.body: A serpentine, fish-like creature with scales, fins, and a tail, featuring a glowing lotus on its back.
